In the very first exercise, they ask a question which I thought would be trivial with Rattle, but it had been a couple of years since I'd last installed and used it, (and having changed computers, environments, and companies) I first fought with the installation.

Given a data set ( “http://stat.columbia.edu/~rachel/datasets/nyt1.csv”) their first assignment is to create categories (a new variable "age_group") <18, 18-24, 25-34,35-44, 45-54,55-64, and 65+)

Transform "seemed" to be the natural place but none of the transformations seem to do what is requested.

Is this just my not seeing the tree in the forest, or must such transformations be done outside of Rattle?
